title: How to Localize the Website | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: How to Localize the Website Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000003018 The Primary Country setting is used to fall back on or recommend to users when maps/map searches are needed. Primary Country Setting Go into Settings >> General Settings >> Localization: Location Search Suggestions By default, whenever a user does a search by location, it will recommend suggestions from all around the world; however, if the website is intended to be used in one country only, the searches should be in the intended country. Default Map Pin The Primary Country setting is also used to set the default map pin: This applies to the following forms: Lead Form Member Contact Details ( shown above ) Service Areas Single Image and Group Posts The map pin location can be customized using the advanced settings Default Center Map Location System Variable : default_center_map_lat_lon When using this setting, add the latitude and longitude coordinates separated by commas. Example: 41.019696,-99.888992 Service Areas Display Behavior Also, if the Location Search Suggestions setting is configured to Include All Countries , the country associated with the Service Areas will be displayed: If the setting is configured to Only Search Within Primary Country , the country associated with the Service Areas will be hidden: For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
